name: Holiday Hijinks: House on Haunted Hill
source:
Erin and Jack are asked to handle a 'ghost problem' in a local seemingly abandoned mansion. While investigating the dilapidated home, they find out it may not be quite as abandoned as it initially seemed...and that they may have gotten into a lot more than they were being paid for.

[From[url=http://www.polymorphicgames.com/?q=node/35] polymorphic games[/url]]
translation:
艾琳和杰克被要求处理当地一座看似废弃的豪宅中的“幽灵问题”。在调查这栋破旧的房屋时，他们发现它可能并不像最初看起来那样被遗弃……而且他们可能得到的东西可能比他们所支付的要多得多。

[来自[url=http://www.polymorphicgames.com/?q=node/35]多态游戏[/url]]
